description: ONS publishes daily instantaneous and integrated maximum demand for electricity subsystems. Fields include the times of both measures and their values. Coverage includes supervised and scheduled plants plus estimated micro- and mini-distributed generation derived from forecast weather. These observations and estimates support peak-demand and capacity studies. The dictionary states MW for instantaneous demand but uses MWhmedio for the integrated measure; that unit needs clarification before comparison or conversion. Coverage is electricity subsystems in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
